STATUS: pass

SUMMARY: I ran 21 probes covering every extra case you listed plus the main acceptance criteria. All 21 passed on the first clean run, so I found no reproduced blocking bugs. The only findings are minor: a missing file named in the scope and a few placement and docs nits.

FILES TOUCHED: none. I created `src/__probe__.test.tsx`, ran it, and deleted it. `git status --short` matches the starting state (README.md, index.ts, and the six new component and test files).

FINDINGS:
- [minor] `FEATURE_FLOW.md` is listed in FILES but does not exist in the repo and is not in the diff. Not reproduced as a defect in the code; it is a scope question.
- [minor] The "No results" message is a `role="status"` div placed beside the listbox, not inside it. The spec only requires that it is not a `role="option"`, so this passes, but a reviewer may want it inside the listbox. Not reproduced as a failure.
- [minor] Tab disables via the native `disabled` attribute and never sets `aria-disabled`. T5 allows either, so this is not a failure.
- [minor] Option ids use the index into the full `options` array, so they shift when options are reordered while open. Not reproduced as a problem, since `aria-activedescendant` is recomputed on each render.

CHECKS:
- Combobox in Dialog: Escape while listbox open → listbox closes, dialog stays open; second Escape closes dialog → pass
- Combobox in `<form>`: Enter while open (no active, then active) does not submit; Enter when closed submits → pass
- Two Tabs with identical values → all tab and panel ids unique → pass
- Odd tab values (`"a b"`, `x/y`, `q"u`, `a_b` vs `_95_`, `a.b`, `é`, empty string, `a:b`, NBSP) → unique ids, and every aria-controls and aria-labelledby resolves to the right role → pass
- Dialog with focusables inside `display:none` and `hidden` subtrees → focus goes to the visible button → pass
- Dialog open→close→open ×3 → focus returns to the opener each time → pass
- Dialog with no focusables: Tab and Shift+Tab keep focus on the dialog → pass
- Dialog Escape in a nested input closes; Enter and Space do not → pass
- Dialog drag from inside to backdrop does not close; backdrop click does → pass
- Dialog opener removed before close → no throw, dialog closes → pass
- Tabs selected tab becomes disabled → selection falls to first enabled tab, one tabbable, no onValueChange → pass
- Tabs selected tab removed → selection falls back, panel shown → pass
- Tabs all-but-one disabled, with ArrowLeft/Right/Home/End → stays on the enabled tab → pass
- Tabs DOM reorder → arrow order follows DOM → pass
- Tabs controlled, parent ignores onValueChange → aria-selected unchanged → pass
- Combobox options change while open, active option removed → aria-activedescendant gone, Enter no-op → pass
- Combobox value label changes while open → input shows new label → pass
- Combobox regex metacharacters `(`, `.*`, `[` treated literally; whitespace trimmed → pass
- Combobox all filtered options disabled → no active option, Enter no-op → pass
- Combobox controlled, parent ignores onChange → input reverts after choose, listbox closes → pass
- Combobox blur with typed text → restores the controlled label, no onChange → pass
- Combobox no matches → "No results" shown, no role=option, no aria-activedescendant → pass
- Not run: `pnpm test` and `pnpm typecheck` (the orchestrator already ran them).

OPEN QUESTIONS: Is `FEATURE_FLOW.md` required? It is listed in the scope but is absent from the repo and the diff.
